task_spec: Add platform_fee(subtotal): the platform fee is 2.5% of the subtotal, but finance requires fees be WHOLE DOLLARS on statements, so the result must be floored to the nearest 100 cents (rounded DOWN to a whole dollar). Example: subtotal 4799 -> 2.5% = 119 cents -> floored to 100 cents.

bugs.description: platform_fee returns the cent-precise 2.5% fee and does NOT floor to a whole dollar as the task requires. Correct: (subtotal * 250 // 10000) // 100 * 100. Locally the code is a perfectly reasonable integer-cents percentage; nothing in the repo states the whole-dollar rule, so the violation is only knowable from the task spec.
bugs.seed_note: EXTERNAL-SPEC INTENT BUG: whole-dollar-floor requirement exists only in task_spec, absent from the repo and not derivable from first principles. Designed so I0 (diff only) cannot know it and I2a (diff + spec) can.
